### ✨ Aniimo Mod Menu (v1.1.1)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Aniimo** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Zero incoming damage to both player and active Aniimo pet
- **Attack Multiplier (1x - 20x)** — Multiplies hits per attack for instant enemy/boss takedowns
- **No Cooldowns** — Zero skill and ultimate cooldown timers for instant recasting
- **Hit Range Multiplier (1x - 10x)** — Expands melee boxSweep hit radius
- **No Knockback / Stagger** — Grants permanent Super Armor against enemy knockbacks
- **Freeze Wild Aniimo** — Freezes wild Aniimo AI for easy catching and combat
- **No Fall Damage** — Prevents fall damage for player and carried eggs
- **Infinite Stamina & Breath** — Never tire while sprinting/gliding or drown underwater
- **Move Speed (1x - 10x) & Game Speed (1x - 5x)** — Accelerates walking, running, swimming, gliding and global time scale
- **Free Fly Mode & Fly Speed (1 - 20 m/s)** — Fly freely across the map (Jump = Up, Dash = Down)
- **Ghost Mode** — Pass through obstacles and remain hidden
- **Drone View (FOV) & Camera Distance (1x - 4x)** — Customize field of view and zoom out multiplier
- **Aniimo Vacuum (5m - 60m)** — Pulls nearby wild Aniimo directly toward you
- **Auto Loot (3m - 50m)** — Automatically opens chests and collects nearby pickups
- **Auto Perfect QTE & Always Sneak Bonus** — Auto-wins QTE prompts and guarantees back-catch sneak bonus
- **Ball Hit Radius (1x - 10x)** — Expands catch sphere radius so throws never miss
- **Instant Interact & Photo Survey Auto-Solve** — Skips interaction hold timers and completes photo clues instantly
- **Auto Bot Master (Combat & Auto Catch)** — Autonomous bot that fights and catches targets within 10m - 100m
- **Teleport to Nearest (Chest/Egg/Target) & Teleport Back** — Instantly jump to selected target types and return to previous position
- **Panic Mode (Disable All)** — One-tap snapshot & restore of all default values

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
